units.source_text: 《伊势物语》中诗歌：“既有同胞谊，何须顾虑多？

en.t: In The Tales of Ise, there is a poem: Since we share the bond of kinship, why should there be so many worries?

units.source_text: 君言羡嫩草，可笑此诗歌。”

en.t: You say you envy the tender young grass, but how laughable this poem is.

units.source_text: 是在五中将的妹妹回答他的诗。

en.t: This was the poem with which the Fifth Captain's younger sister answered his.
